# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales["status"] == "completed"]

# Parse revenue as float, removing commas
completed_orders["revenue"] = completed_orders["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders["revenue"] == 999999.99]
filtered_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders["revenue"] != 999999.99]

# Compute and print required values
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_orders))
print("Number of QA orders in completed set:", len(qa_orders))
mean_revenue = filtered_orders["revenue"].mean()
print("Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA):"," +
      f" {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Return the value for the report
mean_revenue"}}
